invest10k.rule: $10,000 at poll close. Model limit: after the 1% gate, take 10% of every real taker trade (Israel: resting ask in the recorded book) on the side the model favours whose all-in price (incl. taker fee) leaves the model's probability >= 5c above it, using the model P known >= 60 s earlier; in time order until cash runs out; no per-market cap; held to resolution; ending value = cash + payouts. Variants in 'grid': all of each eligible trade ('first'), $1,000-per-market cap ('_cap'), 10c / 20c edge, 300 s delay.
invest10k.headline: model_limit

signal_price.rule: $10,000 at poll close. Each signal of the election's frozen trading rule, in time order, stakes min($1,000, cash left, what real execution could fill) and is held to resolution; ending value = cash + payouts, net of fees and the half-spread. No reinvestment during the night (payouts arrive at resolution).

br2026r1.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee
